claims.claim_text: After power breaks ge-0/0/1 can stay in loss of signal even when the far end is transmitting, and the port is probably not dead. Disable and enable the interface once before anyone drives out, and only if the alarm stays after that check the RX level on the SFP.
claims.symptom: port stays in LOS after a power break while the far end is transmitting
claims.action: disable and enable the interface once
